description: This file defines the sealed class PdfGraphicsState within the PdfSharp.Drawing.Pdf namespace. It manages the current graphics state in a PDF context, including transformations, stroke and fill styles, clip paths, and font states. The class provides methods for pushing and popping graphics states, realizing pen and brush settings, managing transformation matrices, and handling clip paths, all tailored for PDF rendering with detailed control over graphics properties.

classes.name: PdfGraphicsState
classes.description: Represents the current PDF graphics state, managing transformations, stroke and fill styles, clip paths, and font states for PDF rendering within the PdfSharp library.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the current graphics state object.

methods.name: PushState
methods.description: Saves the current graphics state onto the stack, represented by appending 'q/n'.

methods.name: PopState
methods.description: Restores the previous graphics state from the stack, represented by appending 'Q/n'.

methods.name: RealizePen
methods.description: Configures the graphics state to match the specified pen's style, including line width, dash pattern, cap, join, and color.

methods.name: RealizeBrush
methods.description: Configures the fill style, supporting solid colors and gradients, based on the given brush.

methods.name: RealizeFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color, taking into account color mode (RGB or CMYK) and transparency.

methods.name: RealizeNonStrokeTransparency
methods.description: Applies transparency to fill styles based on the provided transparency level.

methods.name: RealizeFont
methods.description: Ensures the current font is set up properly with the renderer, including size and rendering mode.

methods.name: AddTransform
methods.description: Modifies the current transformation matrix by pre-multiplying with a given matrix, considering page direction.

methods.name: RealizeCtm
methods.description: Finalizes and applies the current transformation matrix to the PDF content stream.

methods.name: SetAndRealizeClipRect
methods.description: Creates and applies a clipping rectangle to the graphics state.

methods.name: SetAndRealizeClipPath
methods.description: Creates and applies a custom clip path to the graphics state.
